**Data Scientist III, Forward Deployed** at Mozn AI · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

## About

I am a data scientist with three years of client-facing work in banking,
public finance, healthcare, education and Hajj operations, building models
that run inside the client's environment. I am the author of
[autoLRP](https://github.com/Wa-lead/autoLRP), an open-source library for
explaining PyTorch models.

## Selected Work

### In production at Mozn AI

**Anti-fraud, Alrajhi Bank.** Turned card-fraud rule discovery into a
local-search optimization, taking a weeks-long manual process to minutes;
the deployed rules cut card fraud by about 25%. Real-time mule-cashout
controls prevent about 3M SAR/month at 50% precision.

**Budget validation, Ministry of Finance (NCGR).** Fine-tuned embedding
models so comptrollers can cross-check allocations: 70% Hits@5, against 28%
for off-the-shelf embeddings. Two-stage OCR for handwritten Arabic digits.

**Digital Mentor, Health Specialties Commission (SCFHS).** A Bayesian model
(PyMC, MCMC) of rank-based nominations that simulates each candidate's
chance of nomination: F1 about 0.84, against 0.39 for the baseline. Bias
testing and outcome KPIs endorsed by the Deputy Secretary.

**Learner analytics, National eLearning Center (NeLC).** Led 30+ analytical
and ML models for 200,000+ learners, including course recommendation and a
learning-pathway optimizer. API response time cut from about 5 s to 150 ms.

**Season analytics, Ministry of Hajj and Umrah.** Analyzed 100M+ records in
Polars, finding fraudulent campaigns and price manipulation; the reports
informed the Deputy Minister's enforcement decisions.

### Proofs of concept

**Public-services assistant, MEWA.** RAG assistant over 300+ services,
served with vLLM on GCP; a custom tree-structured retriever scored 96%
against 82% for an OpenAI-embedding baseline.

**Medical exam question generator, SCFHS.** Grounded LLM generator for
SMLE-standard questions at 2.5× baseline throughput; won a second-phase
engagement.

**Compliance auditing, Central Bank (SAMA).** Agentic LLM pipeline that turns
policy documents into checks, runs them against an audited entity's data and
reports the gaps.

## Open Source

[**autoLRP**](https://github.com/Wa-lead/autoLRP) (author). Layer-wise
Relevance Propagation for any PyTorch model without a rewrite, tested on
CNNs, ViT, LLMs, Mamba and world models. MIT-licensed, on PyPI as `autolrp`.

[**needle**](https://github.com/Wa-lead/needle-pytorch-from-scratch). A
PyTorch-like framework built from scratch: autodiff, a C++ backend, a layers
API and a Transformer language model on top.

[**SimEngine**](https://github.com/Wa-lead/SimEngine). Text-similarity
toolkit with BERT, FastText and NER-based methods.
